# Setup

```{R}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})

```

# Read in all metrics
```{R}
read_in_analysis <- function(this_csv) {
  in_file <- read.csv(this_csv)
  
  # Split up file name, some profilers have "_"
  fn <- basename(this_csv)
  parts <- stringr::str_split(fn, "_", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  n <- length(parts)
  
  this_profiler <- paste(parts[1:(n-2)], collapse = "_")
  this_depth    <- parts[n-1]
  this_err      <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(parts[n])
  
  out_df <- in_file |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(sample_name = sample, 
           sample = sub("healthy_stool_", "", sample_name)) |> 
    separate("sample", c("num_species_present", "species_dominance_score"),
             sep = "_", convert = TRUE) |>
    mutate("total_bases" = this_depth,
           "error_status" = this_err,
           "profiler" = this_profiler)
  return(out_df)
}
```
## Loop through
```{R}
all_profilers <- c("PathoScope2", "Bracken", "MetaScope", "MetaScope_priors", "MetaScope_blast", "Kraken2", "Centrifuge", "mOTUs")
prof_stem <- file.path(stem, "results", "analysis_results")
all_files <- list.files(prof_stem, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

results_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_files, read_in_analysis))

results_combined_cleaned <- results_combined |>
  mutate(total_bases = factor(total_bases, levels = c("100k", "1mil", "10mil"))) |> 
  mutate(profiler = factor(profiler, levels = c(
    "Centrifuge",
    "Kraken2",
    "Bracken",
    "mOTUs",
    "PathoScope2",
    "MetaScope",
    "MetaScope_priors",
    "MetaScope_blast"
  ), labels = c(
    "Centrifuge",
    "Kraken2",
    "Bracken",
    "mOTUs",
    "PathoScope2",
    "MetaScope",
    "MetaScope Priors",
    "MetaScope Blast"
  )
  ))

```

# Visualizations

## Boxplots
```{R}
for (this_metric in c("r2", "rmse", "rrmse", "nrmse", "avgre", "MCC")) {
  p <- results_combined_cleaned |>
    mutate("Species Dominance Score" = as.factor(species_dominance_score)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = profiler, y = !! sym(this_metric),
               color = profiler,
               fill = profiler)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(`Species Dominance Score` ~ total_bases) +
    ylab(this_metric) +
    xlab("Profiler") +
    labs(title = paste("Boxplot of", this_metric)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave(file.path(fig_stem, paste0("boxplot_", this_metric, ".png")),
         p,
         units = "in", width = 10, height = 13)
  print(p)
}

```
## ROC Curves

```{R}
p_roc <- results_combined_cleaned |>
  ggplot(aes(x = FPR, y = TPR,
             color = as.factor(species_dominance_score),
             shape = total_bases))+
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Dominance Scenario") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(0, 2, 3),
                     name = "Sequencing Depth") +
  facet_grid(profiler ~ num_species_present) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity"
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_stem, paste0("ROC.png")), p_roc,
       units = "in", width = 10, height = 15)
# type of points - no fil
```
